svg.aria-label: Sir ar Last Date: Teachers upload a roster and a deadline and see who pushed to GitHub on time. Runs on Cloudflare Workers; the token stays server-side. How it works: the browser reads the roster and builds the spreadsheet report; a Cloudflare Worker holds the GitHub token and asks the GraphQL API only about the repos.
